FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Injury coverage pays your own hurt no matter the fault while property coverage pays damage you inflict on others [A01].
Why it matters: group no-fault; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Minimums sit at $10,000 each from a licensed carrier, and lapses suspend up to three years unless plates surrender first [A01].
Why it matters: group no-fault; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F02, sec03-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A02
Missing proof forces a court date while a forged card forces an arrest, and month-old suspensions allow plate seizure [A02].
Why it matters: group lapse-fallout; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F04, sec03-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A02
DUI tiers run $100,000, $300,000, and $50,000 for three years against $10,000, $20,000, and $10,000 or $30,000 combined for lesser triggers [A02].
Why it matters: group responsibility-tiers; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F06, sec03-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A03
Sixteen-year-olds stop from 11 pm to 6 am while seventeen-year-olds stop from 1 am to 5 am, both excused for work or a senior companion [A03].
Why it matters: group curfews; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A03
Borrowed disabled permits draw $500 or six months with towing, while proper permits waive meters and open reserved bays [A03].
Why it matters: group parking-permits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A03
DUI spans alcohol through store-bought drugs, suspends at arrest for BAL .08 or refusal, and compels tests by signed consent [A03].
Why it matters: group dui-scope; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A04
A first refusal costs one year while a second costs 18 months plus a misdemeanor, and bloody crashes force draws regardless [A04].
Why it matters: group refusal; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A04
DUI fines, jail, schooling, and interlock all climb across first, second, and third convictions with high-BAL enhancement [A04].
Why it matters: group dui-ladder; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F13, sec03-F14, sec03-F15 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A04
Under-21 drivers fall at BAL .02 for six months, study at .05, and trigger parent notice under 19 [A04].
Why it matters: group zero-tolerance; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F16 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A05
Litter to 15 pounds costs $100 while heavier loads bring a misdemeanor, $1,000, three points, and cleanup [A05].
Why it matters: group litter; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F18 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A05
Plain bus passing costs points and hundreds while injurious passing costs service hours, a year out, and $1,500 [A05].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F19 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A05
Belts cross hips and chest with airbags never substituting, and under-13 riders belong behind [A05].
Why it matters: group belts; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F20 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R14 | anchor: A06
Under-4 riders need seats with ages 4 and 5 seated or boosted, drivers answer for minors, and adults answer for themselves [A06].
Why it matters: group restraints; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F21 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R15 | anchor: A06
Belt exemptions favor medical cases, paper routes, old buses, paid buses, farm gear, and heavy trucks past 26,000 pounds [A06].
Why it matters: group exemptions; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F22 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R16 | anchor: A07
Speeding past 50 over costs $1,000 then $2,500 while zone speeding doubles toward $1,000 with a possible course [A07].
Why it matters: group speeding; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F24 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R17 | anchor: A07
A third crash offense inside 36 months forces schooling, wheel hours, and an extended test within 90 days [A07].
Why it matters: group crash-rule; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F26 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R18 | anchor: A07
Point clocks suspend at 12, 18, and 24 across lengthening windows, while minors fall to business-only at 6 [A07].
Why it matters: group points; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F27, sec03-F28 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R19 | anchor: A08
Speed points step 3, 4, 6 by margin and crash, and texting adds 3 alone, 3 in zones, or 6 in crashes [A08].
Why it matters: group point-table; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F29 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec03-R20 | anchor: A08
Signals, bus passing, and recklessness cost 4 each, injurious bus passing costs 6, and hour and handheld breaches cost 3 [A08].
Why it matters: group point-table; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F30 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec03-R21 | anchor: A09
Suspension pauses privileges, revocation ends them, and cancellation voids them from the start [A09].
Why it matters: group privilege-ladder; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F32, sec03-F33, sec03-F34 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec03-R22 | anchor: A09
DUI alcohol and refusal appeals need review-office hearings inside 10 days of arrest [A09].
Why it matters: group hearings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F35 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0039]
